deploySampleEvidence.exitCondition: Attach staging deploy samples proving logs, metrics, public errors and audit responses contain no secrets or raw provider/source/prompt payloads.

requiredChecks.requiredSignal: committed files contain no private keys, secret-like environment values, generated keys or credential URLs outside documented placeholders
high and critical dependency vulnerabilities have no unapproved exception
JWT/OIDC, workspace membership, tenant isolation and beta dev-header rejection stay green
problem details, nested diagnostics and audit metadata redact secret-looking keys and values
audit list endpoint is tenant-scoped and audit metadata is redacted before persistence
source credentials, webhook secrets and diagnostic records are encrypted or redacted through approved runtime boundaries

forbiddenRuntimeLeakClasses.requiredMitigation: redact secret-looking keys, generated keys, credential URLs and authorization strings before serialization
store source/provider payload details only in controlled persistence fields and expose support-safe ids/statuses
summary gates may expose fixture ids, citation ids, source window ids and cost counters, not raw prompt or source body text

externalBetaExitCriteria: Security final sweep gate is green on the release commit.
Staging deploy log, metric, public-error and audit-response samples are attached for the promoted image digest.
Any exception has owner, expiry, mitigation and remains blocking until explicitly approved.
